scope: Separate next native/application research round; no compiler/launcher/build integration, core ownership model lane or blocked tooling.
provider_constraint: GPT-6.1 Sol high, per parent campaign instruction
production_policy: Only concrete red-first findings justify a minimal production edit after parent coordinates the specific file boundary.
question: Do long mixed mesh create/update/delete and terrain-edit traces preserve handle/borrowed buffer/lighting invariants and bounded steady-state storage?

current_gap.description: Current bitmap trace checks creation/deletion over a fixed bounded run, while valid uploads and long terrain churn are not covered together.

prepare: Compile real graphics.c with typed glBufferData/glDrawArrays stubs that capture upload length, byte checksum and draw vertex count, then compare independent expected commands; no GLFW initialization/display.

Compile actual terrain/meshing/physics modules for a bounded explicit World. Add a separate independent Python byte-world/top/torch-set/dirty-chunk model; use exact opaque/material rules as a table, not copied terrain algorithms.
Freeze source/compiler/fixture hashes and record exact generated sanitizer attributes with prepare_llvm_for_link; native C ASan/UBSan and generated ASan remain distinct.
Keep large binary/output artifacts only in build; evidence sources, trace hashes, summaries and failing minimized inputs stay durable.

bounds.finite_pool_extension: If short correctness pilot passes, bounded fixed/lazy K32 cohorts scheduled separately; eager baseline included in pilot. No simultaneous heavy/timing jobs.

event_families.name: handle churn
event_families.operations: Create smallest available slot, valid update, draw, delete; varied deletion order, reuse, bulk fill/drain, low-hole reinsertion and adversarial delete-first/create-first/create-new sequences.
event_families.oracle: Independent occupied bitmap plus command byte/draw-size oracle; retain exact current handle reuse and invalid/deleted/double-delete diagnostics.

event_families.name: borrowed Bytes refill
event_families.operations: Mesh buffer is updated, cleared, refilled with larger/smaller geometry, aliased in language and released at frame exit; native stubs hash borrowed data during call and retain no pointer.
event_families.oracle: Expected upload byte identity, extension counts and API sequence; this simulates CPU ABI borrowing, not driver or GPU lifetime.

event_families.name: terrain edits
event_families.operations: AIR/STONE/WATER/GLASS/TORCH changes, repeated no-op writes, boundary positions, torch insertion/removal and out-of-world controls; sample affected chunk remesh.
event_families.oracle: Independent byte store, distinct torch set, column top scan and dirty bitmap; special-case exposed cube/water/floor geometry, otherwise bounded paired mesh identity.

event_families.name: steady storage
event_families.operations: Repeated same-size batches, occasional bounded maximum bursts, idle frame/poll cleanup checkpoints and final full drain.
event_families.oracle: Existing runtime testing stats through a test adapter, native allocation/realloc live bytes/high water and fixed-capacity failure controls. RSS sampled as supporting evidence, not proof; allowance separates live fixture state, reserved capacity, cached frames and pending work.

event_families.name: fault controls
event_families.operations: Child processes inject registry realloc and upload-preparation allocation failures, invalid handles and malformed vertices at deterministic checkpoints.
event_families.oracle: Exact diagnostics and stop behavior; failures cannot poison the successful run. No production fault injection.

execution.pilot: First run a small deterministic seed set at O0/O2/ASan across selected heap profiles; regressions must fail before any fix.
execution.soak: Only after pilot passes run active bounded event batches until both target duration and minimum batch coverage are met, with a hard maximum wall/CPU bound; do not sleep to pad duration. Parent owns timing/compilation reservations.
execution.rng: Recorded seeds and event counts, independent generator, bounded trace export for replay/minimization.
execution.checkpoint: Check full independent invariants, source unchanged, live allocations/storage, cleanup debt disposition and output hashes; save immediately on failure/timeouts.
execution.performance: Count-only attribution during shared-host soak. Quiet-host pairs are a separately reserved experiment; no timing claims from unrelated-load runs.

acceptance: All actual completed event counts/durations derived from machine artifacts, no planned-duration claims.
Long-run steady-state requested/live native storage plateaus within derived bounds after drain/checkpoints; any caching/pending debt is separately accounted.
No malformed upload/read, native/LLVM ASan report, incorrect smallest-free handle, duplicate torch membership or deterministic output drift.
All source reconstruction and failed/minimized event traces survive process failure.
Document unsupported/unmeasured GPU, platform, I/O and whole-game paths rather than promoting headless soak into exhaustive or HFT proof.
additional_subsystems: PNG large prepared dimensions/chunk ceiling arithmetic and deferred retry; partial-file behavior remains explicit
Overlay glyph/line batching allocation high water and repeated clear/refill
Prepared isolated save/load and native file error handling
Texture atlas/icon and atmosphere cloud CPU mesh generation
Terrain generation and lighting preparation on explicitly sized worlds
Other graph/recursive-tree examples as standalone application traces
